title: AI assistants
text: Editors connect Claude or another MCP client to their site and ask questions about content, dashboards or pages, with their own permissions.

title: Coding agents during development
text: Coding agents on a developer machine inspect and change a local installation through the same actions, without a web server.

title: Integrations and automation
text: Chat bots, monitoring tools or workflow tools call TYPO3 with a token that has only the scopes they need.

title: Imports, migrations and headless clients
text: Record actions read and write all record types. TYPO3 derives the schema from TCA, so developers can generate clients for each installation.

title: A consistent backend
text: The dashboard, the page tree and the file list operations move from internal AJAX routes to actions, with the same validation for all operations.

title: An API for extensions
text: An extension that adds `#[AsAction]` to a method gets an endpoint, documentation and an MCP tool, and EXT:hub handles the authorization.
